# Module History Template

**Document ID:** TEMPLATE-HISTORY

**Schema version:** 1

**Kind:** reference

**Lifecycle:** current

**Subject:** template for an append-only factual module timeline

**Surface:** template

**Boundary:** global

**Authority role:** non-normative

**Mutation:** authored

**Indexing:** exclude

Entries are appended in ascending date order. Earlier entries are not rewritten
to match current architecture. Add a later correction entry when needed.

```text
## YYYY-MM-DD — <BOUNDARY>-HISTORY-001 — Short event title

**Release:** release or none

- Compact factual outcome.

**Evidence:**

- repository-relative audit, migration, release, or validation path
```
